note: Spider 1.0 dev, stratified sample by official hardness: 300 of 1034 proportional within each level, random.Random(2026). id is the question's index in dev.json. Built by experiments/build_spider_eval.py.

questions.question: How many singers do we have?
Show name, country, age for all singers ordered by age from the oldest to the youngest.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name ,  country ,  age FROM singer ORDER BY age DESC

questions.question: What is the average, minimum, and maximum age of all singers from France?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT avg(age) ,  min(age) ,  max(age) FROM singer WHERE country  =  'France'

questions.question: Show the name and the release year of the song by the youngest singer.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT song_name ,  song_release_year FROM singer ORDER BY age LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are all distinct countries where singers above age 20 are from?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM singer WHERE age  >  20

questions.question: How many singers are from each country?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT country ,  count(*) FROM singer GROUP BY country

questions.question: What is the name and capacity for the stadium with highest average attendance?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name ,  capacity FROM stadium ORDER BY average DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show the stadium name and the number of concerts in each stadium.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name ,  count(*) FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id GROUP BY T1.stadium_id

questions.question: For each stadium, how many concerts play there?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name ,  count(*) FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id GROUP BY T1.stadium_id

questions.question: Show the stadium name and capacity with most number of concerts in year 2014 or after.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name ,  T2.capacity FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id WHERE T1.year  >=  2014 GROUP BY T2.stadium_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the year that had the most concerts?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT YEAR FROM concert GROUP BY YEAR ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show the stadium names without any concert.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM stadium WHERE stadium_id NOT IN (SELECT stadium_id FROM concert)

questions.question: Show countries where a singer above age 40 and a singer below 30 are from.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT country FROM singer WHERE age  >  40 INTERSECT SELECT country FROM singer WHERE age  <  30

questions.question: what is the name and nation of the singer who have a song having 'Hey' in its name?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name ,  country FROM singer WHERE song_name LIKE '%Hey%'
